title: Function-call compatibility acceptance matrix for staged rollouts
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Add a deterministic acceptance matrix and runtime validation harness that verifies function-call / structured-output compatibility across canary, A/B, and shadow rollouts. The goal is to detect both syntactic schema mismatches and semantic function-call topology changes (added/removed functions, signature changes, subtle argument retyping) before traffic is promoted.
acceptance_criteria: Create a machine-readable acceptance matrix format that specifies required compatibility properties for a candidate model version (field presence, types, optional flags, allowed enum deltas, function set stability)
Implement a shadow-run harness that compares live responses (structured output and function-call traces) between control and candidate models and computes divergence scores per-request and aggregated

Integrate fuzzy schema-diffing that tolerates benign changes (new optional fields, additional enums whitelisted) and flags breaking changes (removed fields, type narrowing, missing required function signatures)
Add rollout policy hooks: if divergence_rate > threshold or critical function mismatch observed, automatically throttle or rollback candidate traffic and emit actionable diagnostics
Expose per-route telemetry to Console: drift heatmaps, top offending example inputs, function-call callgraph diffs, and time-series of compatibility regressions
implementation_plan: Design acceptance-matrix YAML schema and JSON Schema representation (spike+doc) — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/design/pull/412
Build instrumentation in runtime to emit canonicalized function-call traces (name, arg schema, call latency, token counts) and structured-output fingerprints
Implement fuzzy-diff library in inference-service (go) that compares expected vs observed schemas and returns a graded diff (info/warn/error)
Wire shadow-run comparator service to the rollout controller with API: /compare?run_id=&model_pair= — produce per-request diff IDs
Add console visualization panels (rollout detail) and new traces in tracing UI; add alerting rules for auto-rollback triggers
Iterate with PM and Design on UX for presenting diffs and remediation suggestions
risks_mitigation: False positives from overly strict schema rules: mitigate by allowing per-route whitelists and a learning period where new fields are auto-classified as optional
Performance overhead of shadow tracing: implement sampling and efficient canonicalization, only enable full tracing for canaries by default
Operator confusion on fuzziness thresholds: provide sane defaults and UI tooltips, include a fallback suggestion engine
Security: ensure function-call traces are scrubbed of PII before storage; default redact rules and allow KMS-backed encryption
notes: We want to support both JSON Schema-style structural checks and function-level semantic checks (e.g., calling a newly introduced function that returns binary blobs is OK if whitelisted)
Prototype fuzzy diff algorithm borrowed from earlier eval work but extended to handle function-call graphs and optional-flag reconciliation
This ticket focuses on the runtime validation and rollout integration; separate follow-ups will cover autogenerated migration hints and SDK helpers
Eng review requested from: Priya Menon (runtime), Jon Becker (rollouts-control-plane), and Lina Zhou (console)
Estimated infra egress/storage impact: small for aggregates; full traces stored only when investigating an incident
